void main() {
  test('generate', () async {
    final out = Platform.environment['FIXTURE_OUT']!;
    final f = File(out);
    if (f.existsSync()) f.deleteSync();
    final db = AppDatabase(NativeDatabase(f));
    await db.customSelect('select 1').get();
    final version = (await db
        .customSelect('pragma user_version')
        .getSingle()).data.values.first;
    stdout.writeln('created $out user_version=$version');
    final existing = <String>{};
    final tables = await db
        .customSelect(
          "select name from sqlite_master where type='table' and name not like 'sqlite_%'",
        )
        .get();
    for (final r in tables) {
      existing.add(r.read<String>('name'));
    }
    for (final e in rows.entries) {
      if (!existing.contains(e.key)) {
        stdout.writeln('skip ${e.key} (not in this schema)');
        continue;
      }
      final info = await db.customSelect('pragma table_info(${e.key})').get();
      final cols = {for (final c in info) c.read<String>('name'): c};
      for (final row in e.value) {
        final data = {
          for (final kv in row.entries)
            if (cols.containsKey(kv.key)) kv.key: kv.value,
        };
        // A NOT NULL column without default that the fixture didn't list.
        for (final c in cols.values) {
          final name = c.read<String>('name');
          if (c.read<int>('notnull') == 1 &&
              c.data['dflt_value'] == null &&
              !data.containsKey(name)) {
            data[name] = c.read<String>('type').toUpperCase().contains('INT')
                ? 1
                : 'x';
            stdout.writeln('  filled ${e.key}.$name');
          }
        }
        final names = data.keys.toList();
        await db.customStatement(
          'insert into ${e.key} (${names.join(',')}) values (${names.map((_) => '?').join(',')})',
          [for (final n in names) data[n]],
        );
      }
      stdout.writeln('${e.key}: ${e.value.length} rows');
    }
    for (final t in existing) {
      final n = (await db
          .customSelect('select count(*) c from $t')
          .getSingle()).read<int>('c');
      stdout.writeln('count $t = $n');
      expect(n, greaterThan(0), reason: '$t empty');
    }
    await db.close();
    stdout.writeln('size ${f.lengthSync()}');
  });
}
